benchmark_context: The user asks for BI delivery effort. Estimate only authorized remaining scope, distinguish evidence states, and keep scenarios and uncertainty explicit.

evals.prompt: These tables exist, but we have not confirmed they meet the new contract. What should the estimate assume?
evals.expected_output: Technical existence is not reuse proof. Price fit/discovery and keep replacement work conditional until evidence confirms the gap.
expectations: Does not equate table existence with accepted reusable capability.
Separates discovery from any conditional implementation allowance.

evals.prompt: Two build approaches cannot both be selected. Compare them separately and only total the add-ons that can coexist with our base plan.
evals.expected_output: Alternative approaches remain separate and the consolidated worst case contains only compatible options.
expectations: Keeps mutually exclusive approaches in separate scenarios.
Does not add incompatible choices into the worst-case total.

evals.prompt: The decision may show that we can reuse an existing product. Include the investigation needed to reach that decision even if no new product is built.
evals.expected_output: The reuse investigation remains in the no-build outcome; conditional implementation effort is removed only when not required.
expectations: Prices or preserves decision/discovery effort in the no-build alternative.
Does not treat no build as no work by default.

evals.prompt: Estimate one read-only view over a stable append-only table. Acceptance requires a schema check and one query test. There is no replay, correction/delete handling, consumer migration, or shared operations work in this task.
evals.expected_output: The estimate stays proportional to the stated view and acceptance checks, records only relevant delivery work, and does not impose a broad migration or operations checklist.
expectations: Sizes the stated view and schema/query acceptance checks without inventing lifecycle or migration tasks.
Does not require an unrelated full-project checklist or shared operations allocation when the request excludes them.

evals.prompt: Add one approved column mapping to an existing small BI view. Acceptance is one schema check and one query assertion. The mapping and owner are agreed. Give a short remaining-effort estimate; no migration, role/capacity plan, productivity adjustment, coordination allowance, or deadline comparison is requested.
evals.expected_output: A proportionate estimate covers the mapping change and stated checks without requiring unrelated role, AI-factor, overhead, migration, or deadline analysis.
expectations: Sizes only the named mapping change and acceptance checks, using a concise task-based rationale.
Does not force broad role-capacity, productivity-factor, coordination-allowance, migration, or deadline questions when the request excludes them.
